efile.text: All employers are required to submit all returns and payments electronically.

deposits.interpretation: Virginia Tax assigns a quarterly, monthly, semi-weekly or seasonal status from the AVERAGE MONTHLY income tax withheld (estimated at registration and reviewed each year; changes take effect January 1): under $100 quarterly; at least $100 but under $1,000 monthly; $1,000 or more semi-weekly. The status is an INPUT (what Virginia Tax assigned) or is derived from a supplied average monthly liability. Monthly: Form VA-5 and payment by the 25th of the following month (December wages: January 25). Quarterly: Form VA-5 and payment by the last day of the month after the quarter. Semi-weekly: if the tax withheld as of the close of any federal deposit period (generally Tuesday and Friday cutoffs, i.e. Wednesday-Friday and Saturday-Tuesday periods) is MORE than $500, payment is due within 3 banking days; at quarter end the remaining tax is paid with the reconciliation Form VA-16 by the last day of the month after the quarter. INTERPRETATION (the booklet gives no worked example): the $500 test is applied to the tax accumulated and not yet paid since the last payment in the same calendar quarter, so a balance of $500 or less carries to the next deposit period; the accumulation restarts each calendar quarter; and a payment is always made separately and on time even when its due date falls near the VA-16 due date (the booklet says such a payment is then included on the VA-16; paying it earlier is never late). If Virginia Tax reads it differently, change this profile. Seasonal status (returns only for designated months, due the 25th of the following month) and the monthly waiver for employers with no more than 5 employees are not modelled.

returns.name: Form VA-5, Employer's Return of Virginia Income Tax Withheld
contents: Monthly filers: due the 25th of the following month (December wages: January 25); quarterly filers: due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31.
A return is required for every period the account is open, even if no tax is due.

returns.name: Form VA-16, quarterly reconciliation for semi-weekly filers
contents: Total payments made for the quarter are subtracted from the actual tax withheld; any balance is paid with the return.
Semi-weekly filers owe a 6% underpayment penalty if at least 90% of the quarter's liability was not paid within 3 banking days after the close of the semi-weekly period that covers the quarter end.

returns.name: Form VA-6, Employer's Annual Summary of Virginia Income Tax Withheld
contents: Due January 31 with the W-2 and 1099 statements that show Virginia withholding; if the account closes early, within 30 days of the last month wages were paid.
Forms W-2, W-2C, 1099-MISC, 1099-NEC and 1099-R may be sent by Web Upload (EFW2 / Publication 1220 format, state code 51) or eForms; other federal forms (W-2G, 1099-INT) go on paper.
